title: GEMglRasterPos4iv
description: specify the raster position for pixel operations

messages.description: list of the raster position's 4 coordinates (x, y, z and w)

arguments.description: x coordinate of the raster position
y coordinate of the raster position
z coordinate of the raster position
w coordinate of the raster position

body: [GEMglRasterPos4iv] calls glRasterPos4iv() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. See glRasterPos in the OpenGL reference.
